notes: Hall 7 runs to the east wall at x = 2104. That wall was fitted from the three lakeside doors and is past the hall 7/8 partition used for bkkibf-2026. Confirm with PUBAT.
B48 appears twice on the printed plan. Both blocks belong to Amarin Book Center (Naiin) per the exhibitor table, so neither was renamed.
Pillars inside the C28, F30, I30 and L30 blocks and beside C42, L44, F08, I08, L08 and O08 are not modelled. The 30 booths are drawn on the half without the pillar.
This plan draws the toilets about 9 m east of the venue positions (wc1, wc2, wc4, wc5). Venue positions kept.

Exhibitors come from the thailandbookfair.com exhibitor table (316 rows). CHARGESPOT (doors and the pillar by C08) and the Department of Learning Encouragement donation boxes have no booth and are left out.
S01 is listed both as "Unread letter to myself" and as One Reader Inspires Million People Foundation.
